exposure: intrauterine death of fetuses in the third trimester of pregnancy
outcome: Causes of intrauterine death in the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: 98 pregnant women with intrauterine fetal death in the third trimester
finding: Placental factors, umbilical cord factors, and maternal factors, particularly gestational hypertension, were identified as the main causes of intrauterine death in the third trimester of pregnancy.
